statement: (∀ (q a n : ℕ), 3 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → a < q → Nat.Coprime a q → 8000000000 ≤ n → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/(840 * Real.log (n:ℝ))) → let D := fun (q a n : ℕ) => (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=a%q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n:ℝ)/(Nat.totient q:ℝ); let J := fun (q a l u : ℕ) (β : ℝ) => 2 * Real.pi * |β| * (∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico l u, |D q a m|); let T : ℕ := 8000000000; ∀ (q a n : ℕ) (β : ℝ), 3 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → a < q → Nat.Coprime a q → 4000000000000000000 ≤ n → |β| ≤ 105/((q:ℝ)*n) → |D q a n| + J q a T n β ≤ (n:ℝ)/(840*Real.log n) + 105*Real.pi*n/(840*(q:ℝ)*Real.log T)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 裙边与显式算术输入 · SI-8005 · 把 BMOR 的逐前缀估计积成主弧后段误差
plain_statement.en: New route · Skirts and explicit arithmetic inputs · SI-8005 · Sum the BMOR prefix estimates over the late part of the arc budget

brief.zh: 前提逐字取自 PR #2484 的小模数 ψ 声明。对 T≤m<n 用 log m≥log T 并计算等差和；单列终点 n，保留 q 和两处分母的对数。
brief.en: Use the exact small-modulus ψ statement from PR #2484 as a hypothesis. For T≤m<n use log m≥log T and sum the arithmetic progression. Keep n as a separate endpoint with its own logarithm.
